notes: The models picked to replace the map's procedural parts, one entry each (tools/ue_import_model.py imports, fits and registers a pick; tools/fetch_models.py fetches Poly Haven ones; Fab and Sketchfab ones the owner puts under art/thirdparty/models/<folder>/). 'frame' is the part's: cube (a building or mass, a unit cube) or tree (a tree or plant, one tall, one across). docs/scenery/ASSETS.md has the register's rules: a model is added only with the owner's say-so. A pick: {"id": register id, "folder": the source folder under art/thirdparty/models/, "file": the glTF, GLB, FBX or OBJ in it, "part": the part key (map_meshes.hpp MapMeshParts), "variant": optional (a building's variant), "frame": cube or tree, "origin": the page, "author", "licence" (CC0-1.0, CC-BY-4.0, Fab-Standard), "fetched": a date, optional "yaw_deg", "keep_aspect", "notes"}. Then: python tools/prepare_model.py <id> (Blender), and tools/ue_import_model.py with SAM3D_MODEL=<id> (Unreal).
